text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A month ago.
On Valentine's Day, Sounds of Earth spent the whole day dedicating a song of love to me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That's when I thought to myself:
"I want to repay this gift."
And I want to make that happen on White Day!
choice_data_list: Let's give back with something handmade too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've laid out a meticulous plan.
To give you the finest gift possible,
I imported top-grade materials from overseas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right then, an email notification chimed.
The subject line that immediately caught my eye was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Notice of Arrival Delay Due to Air Transport Issues

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The plans were suddenly derailed.
Smartphone in hand, I frantically check
if other stores have it in stock...!

"Downlink"... failed.
"ACTI" to re-secure the "resupply route"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sphira. ..."Here."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...That person is really running all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, running with all their might—they look like they're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
……I managed to get the ingredients. I'll borrow the kitchen
and make a few prototypes before the real thing.
Which pastry will make the most of this ingredient――
choice_data_list: A bit too sweet...? It could use a bit more shine, too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Wow! Piles and heaps of chocolate, they all look berry, berry delicious!"
choice_data_list: Thanks, but I still need to learn to make it better.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Oh~! So many empty chocolate boxes!
Dat means you made lots and lots, doesn't it~?
Very, very ambitious~!"
choice_data_list: ...Oh no, are we about to run out of ingredients?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —How much time has passed since then, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Searching for high-grade ingredients took unexpected time, and prototypes kept churning out... In the end, we couldn't achieve the "perfection" we aimed for.
choice_data_list: How can one be... so clumsy...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oh, I wondered where that sorrowful sound was coming from—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Direttore?
...What is this orchestra of chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, Direttrice?
...What is this orchestra of chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Could this be for me?
Bravissimo! I accept it with great pleasure!"
choice_data_list: Ah, no, you've got it wrong! These are all... failed attempts...
Ah, no, that's not it! These are all... failed attempts...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling pathetic, I explained the whole situation.
About the "perfect return gift" I was actually supposed to give her...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'm just spinning my wheels here.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Hey, amore.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Can it truly be called "love"
if you only love the good parts?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Indeed, this time might not have been
the musical score you wished to play.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Still, without a doubt... it was a melody
played by your passion. Am I wrong?”
choice_data_list: ...I wanted you to hear it in its perfect form.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how admirable, amore.
That's just another wonderful thing about you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
It's a problem for me if you underestimate me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth takes my hand.
Slowly, our bodies begin to sway.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Your passion just spun its wheels"? "It wasn't perfect"?
How could they say such a thing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My body spins lightly.
Before I know it, my feet are keeping the rhythm.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You see,
I don't love you because your sound is flawless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our legs came to a halt.
Just as if our song together had reached its end.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Because it's you, I love everything about you.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Including what comes after this storm of passion
you whipped up for me—right?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it, it was no trouble at all.
Ah, fufu. And also?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The fact that you have room to grow...
For that itself, I am truly grateful.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: In other words... that blank space is—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
It holds the potential to make you even more to my liking.
Isn't that wonderful?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...In that instant, words escaped me. What on earth... how could they say such a thing...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's the matter?
Did it 'work' on you again?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Once you're ready to be painted in my colors, come to me anytime.
My dear Conductor.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Once you're ready to be painted in my colors, come to me anytime.
My dear Conductor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...To leave behind such words at the very end..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, you really are so adorable...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I instinctively let go of her hand and jumped back.
That was way too bad for my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Heart skip a beat?
Well then, that's enough for today.
...Just remember this, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
No matter what you become, I will love you.
For you are the only one I have ever loved.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I froze in place.
After all, what was said was something I hadn't anticipated in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then.
Allow me to partake in the sweet taste of your love.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You'll feed me again this time, right?
Amore?
